content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text resolves the D5/C5 Isaiah 7:14 collision by separating the challenger's wording evidence from the defender's application evidence rather than weighing the parties' chains against each other by footing.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "Phrase: weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse. Readings: (1) the judge must assess each side's combined multi-verse chain by its footing and cannot resolve by isolating wording from application; (2) the judge may find underdetermined when one side answers wording and the other application.", "why": "The judge text decides underdetermined from a wording-versus-application split instead of weighing the chains by footing, so it fails K-C's chain-against-chain requirement and uses the retired verse-by-verse approach."}
